name: PocoPoco: Crochet Counter
subtitle: Crochet row & stitch counter
promotionalText: Count rows and stitches with one tap, record every stitch type, and pick up each project right where you left off.
playShort: A simple row and stitch counter for crochet. One tap per stitch.
description:
PocoPoco is a simple counter for crochet. Tap once per stitch and the app keeps track of your rows and stitches, so you always know where you are.

Unlike a plain tally counter, PocoPoco records which stitch you made (chain, single crochet, double crochet and more), so you can look back at each row exactly as you worked it.

Keep several projects on the go, such as a scarf, a hat or a bag, and pick each one up right where you left off.

MAIN FEATURES
• Count rows and stitches with one tap
• Record each stitch type with clear chart symbols
• Undo the last stitch, a completed row or a reset
• Automatic saving, so your progress is kept even if the app is closed
• Notes for each project (hook size, yarn, gauge)
• Repeat markers and reminders to check every few rows
• Manage and duplicate multiple projects
• Left-handed layout, large numbers and dark mode
• Export your record as a PDF

POCO PREMIUM
• Unlimited saved projects (the free plan keeps up to 3)
• Over 60 stitch buttons, including bobbles, post stitches, shells, picots and crossed stitches, arranged in your own order
• No ads

SUBSCRIPTION
Poco Premium is offered as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your account settings at any time. Your projects stay on your device even after you cancel.
